headline: Design and engineering are {hl}one act of making{/hl} — judged by one standard: does it work in production, for real people?

principles.title: Finished beats impressive
principles.text: A modest product that ships beats a brilliant demo in a slide deck.

principles.title: No half-built anything
principles.text: Every feature ships complete — designed, engineered, tested — or not at all.

principles.title: Precision is the aesthetic
principles.text: A stray pixel or slow query gets fixed, not explained away.
